weekly-lineup.question: What recurring events does Coco Maya host every week in Little Italy?
weekly-lineup.answer: Coco Maya runs four recurring events every week at 1660 India St in Little Italy, San Diego: daily brunch until 3:00 PM, weekday happy hour Monday through Friday from 4:00 to 6:00 PM, nightly dinner from 5:00 PM, and the elevated rooftop patio and glass atrium bar, open every day for walk-ins and reservations.

booking-process.question: How do I book a private event at Coco Maya in Little Italy?
booking-process.answer: Share your date, headcount, and event type through the inquiry form on this page and the Coco Maya events team will follow up within 24 hours. Private events range from an intimate dinner for 10 up to a full venue buyout of 180 guests, on the rooftop patio, in the glass atrium, or throughout the space.

patio-table-vs-buyout.question: Can I reserve a table on the rooftop patio without booking a full private event?
patio-table-vs-buyout.answer: Yes. A standard table reservation on the rooftop patio is separate from a private event or buyout and can be booked directly online. Private events are for groups wanting a dedicated space, custom menu, or full patio buyout, while a regular reservation is the right call for brunch, dinner, or happy hour with a smaller group.

best-time-rooftop.question: What's the best time to visit Coco Maya for rooftop views in Little Italy?
best-time-rooftop.answer: Late afternoon into early evening tends to have the best light on the elevated patio and glass atrium bar, which is also when weekday happy hour runs (4:00–6:00 PM, Monday through Friday). For daytime skyline views over San Diego, daily brunch service until 3:00 PM on the open-air patio is another strong option.
